name: Joseph Edlow
current_role: Director of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
summary: Joseph Edlow directs U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, the agency that processes visas, green cards and naturalization; in 2026 he told Congress the agency wanted its own law-enforcement arm of some 200 officers, separate from ICE and CBP.
